title: Document lost write-response recovery and prove identical note replay
outcome: Document the supported committed-response and identical-replay contract, including exceptions, and prove that a lost note response can be recovered without duplicate evidence
acceptance: docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md documents the code-supported committed-response and retry contract after the queued note/gate correction: callers retain originating identity and original intent, an identical supported keyed replay returns the original IDs without duplication, and exceptions including restored completed gates require show REF --notes --gates readback first. It distinguishes caller response loss from a proven uncommitted refusal, makes no unsupported universal write or native SQLite certainty claim, and adds no outcome lookup, identity parameter or COMMIT branch.

One deterministic regression using the existing Fake/BrokenPipe transport harness around a real note commits the note, loses its reply, re-sends the identical call with retained original identity and intent, and obtains the same original evidence/checkpoint IDs with count one; a fresh reader independently sees exactly one record. No sleeps or new framework.
